back: The age at which a pullet lays her first egg: about 18-22 weeks.
A hen culled because she has stopped laying or lays too few eggs to pay for her feed.
About 16 hours a day; never reduce day length during lay.
Layer: large red comb, moist oval vent, pelvic bones 2-3 fingers apart. Non-layer: pale small comb, dry puckered vent, bones 1 finger apart.
Deep litter: cheaper, more freedom, dirtier eggs. Cages: clean eggs, easy culling and records, more birds; costly and welfare concerns.
Hardy, scavenge, good brooders and mothers, tasty meat; slow growth and fewer eggs. Improve with night housing, extra feed and Newcastle vaccination.
Collect often, do not wash, candle, grade by size, pack broad end up, store cool.
